intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Tamil Nadu by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges tagged as public in our file.

IIT Madras, IIM Tiruchirappalli, NIT Trichy and Anna University are the main public campuses here. AMET University and Vinayaka Mission's Kirupananda Variyar Engineering College are private deemed-university campuses and are no longer tagged as public in our file.
listLead: IIT Madras and IIM Tiruchirappalli appear first. Several cards show a specialised MBA, such as finance, tourism or shipping, so read the programme name before you compare packages.
snapshot: For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, and the highest recorded average is {{pkgMax}}. The recorded years run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
The lowest averages in our file come from specialised tourism or hospitality rows, so read the programme when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Tamil Nadu 2026.
firstCollegesLead: IIT Madras has a 2023 recorded average of ₹20 LPA and a highest of ₹31 LPA. IIM Tiruchirappalli has a 2024 recorded average of ₹21 LPA and a highest of ₹55 LPA on a PGPM Finance row.
In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIT Madras is 13, IIM Tiruchirappalli is 16, NIT Trichy is 57 and Anna University is 88.

sections.heading: Public campuses and tagging issues
paragraphs: Anna University's Department of Management Studies has a 2023 recorded average of ₹12 LPA on an MBA Finance row. NIT Trichy has the same recorded average, with a highest of ₹40 LPA.
AMET University and Vinayaka Mission's Kirupananda Variyar Engineering College are linked to private deemed universities, so they no longer appear on this government list.
